whatsappMessage:
Hi D.Halloween Restro & Cafe Team,

I noticed your cafe has strong 4.3★ reviews across 540+ ratings in Anisabad, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu exploration.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, signature menu items, aur operating timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/dhalloween

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi D.Halloween Restro & Cafe team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (D.Halloween Restro & Cafe) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first menu display, and your strong 4.3★ rating highlight in Anisabad. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
